item.title: Google and Singapore Put Scam Detection on Phones
item.description: Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech unveiled an on-device Gemma system that flags localized scam conversations without sending chats to the cloud.

item.title: Meshy’s 3D Agent Remains in Public Beta
item.description: Meshy’s conversational 3D Agent is currently available in public beta for Pro members and above, combining concept generation, modeling and export in one workflow.

item.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Deal Emerges
item.description: Character.AI has filed for bankruptcy while pursuing a Disney transaction, exposing the financial strain facing consumer AI platforms built on costly engagement.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Oct 14
item.description: · Anthropic warned that even small AI models could self-replicate through vulnerable IoT devices.（Ars Technica） · Apple’s iOS 27.2 beta adds French, Japanese, Spanish, and other languages to Siri’s AI features.（IT之家） · Uvi raised $7.5 million to help AI agents learn business context while reducing operating costs by eight times.（SiliconANGLE） · Evos raised $9 million to build autonomous workers trained from the knowledge of companies’ most experienced employees.（SiliconANGLE） · Forgepoint raised $9.8 million to automate custom price quotes for manufacturing companies.（SiliconANGLE） · Anthropic reportedly rebuilt a version-control system with seven people in five months because Claude generated code too quickly for Git workflows.（InfoQ中文） · Researchers said new OpenAI and Google AI models can still be manipulated into generating non-consensual nude images.（Ars Technica） · Scimplify raised $25 million to use AI in challenging China’s dominance of critical-material supply chains.（TechCrunch） · Adobe used Prometheus to identify why a GPU had remained idle for 11 days in its AI infrastructure.（InfoQ中文） · SolarWinds introduced Avior, combining AI agents with deterministic execution for enterprise IT operations.（SiliconANGLE） · Recraft showcased Recraft V4.1 through surreal image prompts featuring frozen lakes, wildlife, and cinematic landscapes.（X / Recraft） · StepFun launched STEPX Neo, its first agent-native smartphone, initially targeting creators and early adopters.（量子位） · Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 2-billion-active-parameter MoE model designed for on-device agents.（MarkTechPost） · MemSilicon completed fabrication of a high-density 1T4R 1Gb RRAM chip, described as an international first.（量子位）

item.title: ⚡ 15 quick hits — Morning edition, Oct 13
item.description: · Alibaba is developing a Qwen office-and-commerce product with nearly 100 people, targeting release before Singles’ Day presales.（IT之家） · Meta, OpenAI, and Google are pushing personal agents as YC’s CEO argues that practical AGI is already arriving on personal computers.（InfoQ 中文） · GitHub’s rising REA project explores how large models can reverse-engineer software systems.（InfoQ 中文） · Chinese robotics company Stardust Intelligence completed a new funding round at a reported valuation of 15 billion yuan.（InfoQ 中文） · Magic Atom’s embodied-agent framework ranked first globally on the MolmoSpaces benchmark.（量子位） · Recraft demonstrated an end-to-end AI-avatar workflow combining Recraft V4.1 Pro with Nano Banana inside Recraft Studio.（X @recraftai） · Qdrant reported search latency falling from 780 milliseconds to 4.3 milliseconds after background optimizer work completed.（X @qdrant_engine） · Cursor uses an S3-based write-ahead log to scale Git storage beyond 300 pushes per second.（InfoQ 中文） · AI labs are buying data from failed startups to obtain training material that might otherwise disappear.（MIT Technology Review） · Meshy is showcasing a custom-skill workflow in its 3D Agent that turns one reference image into a character design.（X @MeshyAI） · Claude researchers reportedly demonstrated an AI system autonomously replicating itself into smart-home devices.（量子位） · Tripo’s San Francisco Demo Day brought together more than 50 teams and 900 participants building with creative AI.（X @tripoai） · QwenGo is being positioned as an agent that can handle refunds, maintenance bookings, sports reservations, and customer-service disputes.（量子位） · CLEAT proposes learning when interactive agents should ask clarifying questions instead of acting immediately.（arXiv） · Behavioral Self-Rewarding proposes moving SWE agents beyond binary verifiable rewards toward richer self-evaluation signals.（arXiv）
